name.fr-FR: Offices propres de la Congrégation de Jésus et Marie
name.en-US: Proper Offices of the Congregation of Jesus and Mary
name.pt-BR: Ofícios próprios da Congregação de Jesus e Maria

description.fr-FR: Les Offices et les Messes composés par Jean Eudes pour les fêtes de Notre-Seigneur, de la Vierge, de saint Joseph, de saint Gabriel, des saints Prêtres et Lévites et de plusieurs autres saints, selon l’ordre du calendrier (latin et français), avec l’introduction des éditeurs.
description.en-US: The Offices and Masses John Eudes composed for the feasts of Our Lord, the Virgin, St. Joseph, St. Gabriel, the holy Priests and Levites and many other saints, in calendar order (Latin and French), with the editors’ introduction.
description.pt-BR: Os Ofícios e Missas compostos por João Eudes para as festas de Nosso Senhor, da Virgem, de são José, de são Gabriel, dos santos Sacerdotes e Levitas e de muitos outros santos, em ordem de calendário (latim e francês), com a introdução dos editores.

fr-FR.editor: Charles Lebrun, Ange Le Doré, Joseph Dauphin (Congrégation de Jésus et Marie)

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du Vénérable Jean Eudes, tome 11, Vannes (Lafolye) et Paris (Beauchesne), 1905–1911, éd. Ch. Lebrun, A. Le Doré, J. Dauphin; transcription Bibliothèque Saint Libère (liberius.net), 2008.
sources.description: Born-digital transcription of the 1905–11 edition, converted by script: page markers and running heads removed, hyphenation and leaked letter-spacing repaired, paragraphs rejoined; the editors’ footnotes are gathered at the end of the file where they fall; footnote call numbers stay in the running text. The editors’ introductions are kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Eudes died in 1680; the 1905–11 edition is public domain.
